warnings: PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.

Uses the A-01 FLOOR numbers as item numbers -- พ1, พ2, พ3, พ5 -- and each description matches A-01's entry word for word, including the 6"x36" x 2.5 mm vinyl plank size that A-02's specification also gives.

*** พ4 IS MISSING, exactly as ฝ4 is missing from the ceiling sheet. *** A-01 lists พ4 = พื้น ค.ส.ล. ผิวทรายล้าง (washed-aggregate finish), and A-18 tags the ramp as floor finish 4. It carries NO BOQ line here. Either it is absorbed into another item or omitted; the BOQ does not say. Both missing numbers (พ4 and ฝ4) are for EXTERIOR finishes, which may be the pattern.

THE SCREED QUANTITY EQUALS THE VINYL QUANTITY EXACTLY -- 129 ตร.ม. of ปูนทรายปรับระดับพร้อมขัดเรียบ against 129 ตร.ม. of พ1. So the levelling screed is priced only under the vinyl floor, not under the ceramic or the power-floated areas.

*** THE SKIRTING QUANTITY CONFIRMS A-01's RESTRICTION: 62 m of PVC skirting, and A-01 says skirting is 'ใช้กับพื้นปูกระเบื้องยาง' -- for the vinyl floor only. *** It is not measured round the tiled or concrete floors.
FLOOR AREAS TOTAL 207 ตร.ม. (129 + 14 + 36 + 28), which sits almost exactly on the 208 ตร.ม. of ceiling from แผ่นที่ 6/34 -- a good internal cross-check on both sheets.
The 14 ตร.ม. of 12"x12" floor tile matches the two bathrooms, the same area as the ฝ2 moisture-resistant ceiling.
